proposed.name: agent_r1_measurement_0
proposed.rationale: Combines motor timing variability (tapping interval SD) with vocal perturbation (jitter RAP), both dimensionless transforms; captures potential cross-modal coordination of motor control instability.

proposed.name: agent_r1_measurement_1
proposed.rationale: Coefficient of variation of inter-tap intervals scaled by alternation deficit; dimensionless ratio emphasizing motor rhythm irregularity during non-alternating sequences.

proposed.name: agent_r1_measurement_2
proposed.rationale: Log-transformed walking cadence (steps/min) multiplied by log-transformed vocal spectral centroid (Hz); dimensionless combination of locomotor rhythm and voice spectral energy distribution.

proposed.name: agent_r1_measurement_3
proposed.rationale: Absolute deviation from equal button use multiplied by tapping interval CV; dimensionless feature capturing asymmetry in motor lateralization combined with timing variability.

proposed.name: agent_r1_integration_0
proposed.rationale: Interaction between tapping interval variability and voice period perturbation; cross-modal motor control irregularity.

proposed.name: agent_r1_integration_1
proposed.rationale: Asymmetry in button preference weighted by walking pace; links lateral bias with gross motor rhythm.

proposed.name: agent_r1_integration_2
proposed.rationale: Product of tapping interval dispersion and mid-range amplitude shimmer; coordinated stability across fine motor and vocal systems.

proposed.name: agent_r1_integration_3
proposed.rationale: Tapping fatigue (decline in second half) multiplied by pitch variability; endurance-variability cross-domain relationship.
